rationale: Mirrors decisions.py::_resolve_path(), this issue's own cited dispatch model, which anchors its default at the resolved project root rather than a bare cwd-relative path — avoiding the same stray-directory failure mode resolve_ll_dir() exists to prevent.
rule: Default manifest_path resolution: anchor via find_project_root(Path.cwd())
alternatives_rejected: Bare cwd-relative default (Path("ll-workspace.yaml")) — reproduces the stray-.ll/-directory-class bug one level up for callers invoked from a subdirectory or worktree.
